name: Confluence.VC Weekly
author: Clay Norris
blurb: His Sequoia series is the best firm teardown being written today. Part III dissects the actual mechanisms (the onboarding book, the single-no rule, partner manufacturing) that let judgment survive succession. If you study how top firms source and decide, start here.
notes: Swap pitch sent 2026-08-16 via X DM brief (no public email; beehiiv community page). Size-comparable: ~10k+ subs vs our ~30. EU/US investor audience overlap high.

name: Startups and VC: Insights from Stanford Professor
author: Ilya Strebulaev
blurb: The first fully data-driven ranking of the top 100 US VC firms, built on the largest academic unicorn dataset in existence (4,000+ unicorns, 10,000+ funds). The methodology appendix alone is worth your time.
notes: Email verified: istrebulaev@stanford.edu (faculty page). Data-collab fit: he builds academic VC datasets; our SSRN panel is a natural guest-research angle. Swap pitch sent 2026-08-16.
